rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and ZIP, found the correct order, checked product variants, and identified that size 8 was unavailable. It offered an alternative (size 9 leather), accurately noting the synthetic size 9 was out of stock and that the only size 9 leather variant was waterproof. However, before making the order-changing write, the agent did not obtain explicit confirmation to proceed after stating the exact change and price impact; it unilaterally said "I will proceed" and executed the modification. Policy requires explicit user confirmation before any write. The agent also assumed refund to the original payment method and selected PayPal for the modification without explicitly confirming the payment method or verifying the order’s original payment in the order details, though this is secondary. The primary violation—performing a write without explicit confirmation—meets a fail condition.
